description: This Java source file 'HttpTestBase.java' is an abstract base class for HTTP adapter integration tests within the Eclipse Hono project. It contains setup methods, helper functions, and a wide range of test cases verifying message upload, device and tenant authorization, command handling, and concurrency scenarios. The class defines methods for sending messages via HTTP, creating message consumers, and performing detailed assertions on responses and message properties.

classes.name: HttpTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for HTTP adapter integration tests, providing setup, utility methods, and various test cases for verifying device message uploads, command handling, authorization, and concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes static resources and test setup before all tests, configuring HTTP clients and dependency injection.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up each test with fresh device certificates, HTTP clients, and randomly generated tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: deleteObjects
methods.description: Cleans up objects created during tests, such as registered devices and tenants.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Gracefully disconnects from external messaging networks after all tests.

methods.name: commandAndControlVariants
methods.description: Provides a stream of endpoint configurations for various command & control scenarios.

methods.name: commandAndControlVariantsForTestsWithGatewayMappingDisabled
methods.description: Filters variants to those applicable when gateway mapping is disabled for testing.

methods.name: getEndpointUri
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the endpoint URI for requests.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Abstract method to create a message consumer for a given tenant, returning a future that completes with the consumer.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingBasicAuth
methods.description: Tests that messages uploaded with HTTP Basic auth are correctly received via the messaging network.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesViaGateway
methods.description: Tests message upload via a gateway device acting on behalf of a device.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingClientCertificate
methods.description: Tests message upload authenticated via client TLS certificates.

methods.name: testUploadFailsForNonMatchingTrustAnchor
methods.description: Verifies upload fails when device client certificate is signed by an untrusted trust anchor.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Tests that uploads from a tenant with HTTP adapter disabled are rejected with 403.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForDisabledDevice
methods.description: Tests that uploads from a disabled device are rejected with 404.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForDisabledGateway
methods.description: Tests rejection of uploads via a disabled gateway device with 403.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForUnauthorizedGateway
methods.description: Verifies rejection when an unauthorized gateway attempts to upload messages for a device.

methods.name: testHandleConcurrentUploadWithTtd
methods.description: Tests concurrent uploads with time-to-disconnect headers, ensuring commands are delivered as expected.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesWithTtdThatDoNotReplyWithCommand
methods.description: Checks handling of uploaded messages with TTD headers where no command reply is pending.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesWithTtdThatReplyWithCommand
methods.description: Verifies reply with commands during TTD scenarios, including command request/response handling.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesWithTtdThatReplyWithOneWayCommand
methods.description: Tests scenarios where a one-way command is delivered during TTD uploads.
